en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European spa town nestled between wooded hills and an open plain. In the foreground there is a terrace with a railing and tables from a café, overlooking dense blocks of historic multi‑story buildings, churches, and villas. Further back are more residential buildings and open fields with distant hills on the horizon. Along the bottom edge there is German caption text printed in white.
